scope: Real background-noise development audit on the existing 12 coarse THINGS cubes; no galaxy motion or gravity fit.
channel_model: Calibration-only per-channel mean/variance and six-lag Bartlett-tapered Toeplitz correlation, minimum correlation eigenvalue 0.05 before normalization.
spatial_model: Calibration-only Gaussian correlation precision from symmetric lags |dx|,|dy|<=4: least squares to -2*log(correlation), weighted by pair count, using 0.15<correlation<0.98. Fixed 0.01 diagonal nugget for numerical regularization; this is an approximation, not measured white-noise power.
claim_limits: The annulus may contain emission or nonstationary instrumental noise; a failed diagnostic is retained.
Passing heuristic moment gates does not establish exact Gaussian likelihood, separability, mask validity within the galaxy or calibrated chi-square significance.
The cached cube has approximate native-beam treatment; instrument reconstruction remains incomplete.
No velocities, fitted rotation, gas context or source amplitudes enter this noise fit.
All galaxies were used previously. These are guarded spatial validation patches, not independent observing epochs.
